selection: Development GZSL H, then mean S/U, then lower candidate CE. Step zero is eligible. All 30 cells are completed and selections locked before evaluation.
scope: Exploratory SigLIP 2 B/16 follow-up on the fixed cub100 split after its CLIP results were inspected. Native 224 rectangular resize and 768-dimensional embeddings, masks recomputed for full resized views. Frozen backbone, same five matched fusion variants, 3 seeds, 2 learning rates, 400 updates. Fixed temperature 20 for all variants preserves native zero-shot ranking; no claim of native calibrated probabilities. Baseline and controls share native SigLIP preprocessing. This changes backbone, pretraining and preprocessing together; no isolated architecture claim. All selections locked before final SigLIP feature extraction.
tokens: Three views, one separate token per training-supported attribute. All variants share parameters/budgets and fixed detector; pooled repeats its mean to match sequence length; region_only removes text/confidence; permuted and constant are negative controls.
inference: Image only plus fixed detector, class/attribute text assets and trained weights. No image labels, true attributes, or true part locations are inference inputs. Unknown attributes are masked only during probe training and evaluation. Global attribute tokens remain available when detector regions are missing.
